raw_comment: I noticed that the majority of the places with an exceptionally high drought are the Midwest states. I wonder if this high level of drought is because the states in the middle of America are not near large bodies of water. The information from the graph relates to my community because I have noticed that climate change has impacted the weather in the region I live in; the weather has become warmer, and we do not get snow as often anymore. Climate change may also play a role in the extreme droughts in the United States. A catchy headline for the graph could be "Drought Levels Throughout the United States."
